notes: opening best carries the transition from guarded uncertainty into a restrained, vulnerable possibility without overselling hope.
release retains human softness but feels more like the emotional follow-through than the tentative opening itself.
guarded is source-relevant but remains too closed and stern for the intended reconciliation beat.
listener_earlier is a genuine performance but belongs to an unrelated earlier beat; no acceptance of that displacement is stated.
mechanical substitutes spectacle for human subtext and contains no readable reconciliation performance.
